title: Associate Marketing Recruiter | Tamatar Talent
description:
Our Mission

**Tamatar Talent** helps mission-driven, boldly ambitious startups - the ones trying to solve problems that matter, the ones who should win - build their internal marketing, brand, and creative teams. We're an early-stage recruitment marketing firm, and we're building this from zero.

We're looking for someone to be that zero-to-one partner with us: someone who can recruit for marketing roles with real market fluency, real hustle, and real judgment - someone who enables founders to build a much stronger brand by finding them the right marketing talent.

What you'll do

* Talk to founders and brand leaders directly - understand not just what they're asking for, but what they actually need, by asking the right questions and reading between the lines.
* Scout and reach out to candidates on LinkedIn, at volume - this is a manual, high-touch process, and the more organized you are (and the smarter you use AI to help), the further you'll get.
* Use your own judgment to call whether someone's a real fit - for the role and for the business behind it. You'll need to put yourself in the founder's shoes.
* Shortlist candidates, manage the pipeline, and keep communication instant - same-day replies to clients and candidates, always. No one waits two days to hear back from you.
* Close the gap between what a client wants and what a candidate wants - get both sides to yes, without overselling either one.
* Schedule and prep everyone for calls, interviews, and conversations - meticulously.
* Build relationships for the long term, not just the placement - a candidate who isn't right for one role today might be exactly right for something six months from now.
* Help build the processes and systems for how this team recruits - from the ground up, alongside us.

Who we're looking for

**Marketing hiring experience.** You've done non-tech hiring before, mostly for brand, marketing, or GTM roles. You know what "good" looks like in a marketing hire, not just what a job description says.

**Real marketing fluency.** You understand the jargon that comes with the territory, B2B included, and you can tell the difference between what a B2B tech marketer does versus a consumer brand-side marketer, an agency-side digital marketer, and an SEO. You keep track of where the marketing landscape is moving, not just where it's been.

**A consultative seller, not a pusher.** You can convince a brand why a candidate is right, and a candidate why a role is right - but only because you've actually figured out what they need. Sales, to us, means counseling: asking the right question at the right time, never talking someone into the wrong thing.

**AI-fluent.** You already use tools like Claude and Cowork to move faster, and you want to keep getting better at that.

**A real networker.** You're a people person who doesn't run out of energy after talking to 50 people in a day. You want to build a strong network among marketers and brand builders - and you genuinely understand what marketing does for a brand, not just how to source for it.

**Early in your career, but strong and ambitious.** You want to build something real from the ground up, not just execute a job description.

**Organized, prompt, and meticulous.** You read between the lines in a conversation instead of just replying to it. You keep things in order because you genuinely care about being organized, not because someone's checking.

**Curious about how businesses are built.** You want to learn how teams, brands, and companies come together, and you see every client relationship as a chance to learn that.

**A fast learner who solves before you escalate.** In the age of AI, when you're stuck, your first call is to AI and to yourself, not to whoever on the team is closest - you don't disrupt the whole team's flow before you've tried to figure it out. You'll get plenty of feedback when you get things wrong, and that's fine - you're not expected to be scared of mistakes. Own them, be able to explain the call you made and why, and use that to grow faster.

The practical bits

* **Location:** Hybrid, based out of Bangalore.
* **Engagement:** Full-time preferred; open to the right person on a contract or freelance basis.
* **Timeline:** We're in no rush. We're looking for the right person, not the fastest hire

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bangalore City, Bengaluru, Karnataka

You will manage end-to-end expense operations, lead banking disbursements, post critical month-end accruals, and resolve advanced escalations. By partnering cross-functionally with HR, Tax, Payroll, and Audit teams, you will play a key role in strengthening operational excellence, elevating the employee experience, and maintaining world-class financial controls in a dynamic global environment.

Our team culture emphasizes collaboration, accountability, and continuous process improvement. You will step into a hybrid work setup, working in the Bangalore office a minimum of three days a week to enable close partnership with stakeholders while maintaining flexibility. With minimal travel requirements, you can stay focused on day-to-day accounting operations, payment integrity, and regional close priorities.  
  
**Your Role**

* **Expense Operations & Escalations:** Review/approve/reimburse expense reports in your assigned entities. Manage high-volume regional shared inboxes (International/India), categorizing and resolving employee inquiries, Expensify workflow escalations, and system-generated report actions.
* **Mentorship & Team Leadership:** Act as the senior subject matter expert on the floor. Serve as an escalation point and mentor, providing internal guidance, clarification, and training to junior team members on complex policy interpretations.
* **Banking & Disbursements:** Establish and distribute monthly payment schedules. Own, audit, and update the global repository of 1,600+ bank templates for evolving banking standards. * **Policy Compliance & HR Investigations:** Interpret complex expense policy questions, evaluate exceptions and seek necessary exception approvals, and review final expense claim settlements for resigning personnel. Partner closely with HR to investigate audit flags, unusual activity, and policy breaches.
* **Cross-Functional & Audit Collaboration:** Facilitate statutory audit readiness by working directly with international external auditors and India Statutory Auditors on documentation requests. * Working familiarity with India Statutory Audit requirements, CIT tax filing report preparation, and month-end journal/accrual accounting.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to articulate policy decisions professionally and partner cross-functionally across regional borders.

**Work Arrangement** This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. description:
**About us**

  

For well over a century, ExxonMobil has been at the heart of creating and growing a modern world. We embrace the power and promise of technology, pushing the boundaries of what's possible. For billions around the world, lives are better and last longer because of the innovative problem solving and reliable energy we provide. And when it comes to developing industrial solutions to reduce carbon emissions, ExxonMobil is truly the leader.

We don't stop at "good enough." We are committed to doing what's right, even if it's difficult or unpopular. We hold ourselves to high standards, challenge what's possible and invest in innovation to meet society's critical needs.

Real change begins with bold questions, drive, and ambition. Here, your talent, determination and contributions shape how far you'll go and the impact you'll make along the way.

Our future success depends on exceptional people. We invest in developing talent through meaningful work, challenging assignments, mentorship, and experiences that help build the next generation of leaders.

  

**Our Culture**

We are uniquely ExxonMobil. Integrity, care, excellence, resilience and courage, these core values determine how we work every day. At ExxonMobil, our values aren't just words— they're how we show up, focused on delivering the right answer, the right way, every day.

  

**ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India**
------------------------------------

ExxonMobil’s affiliates have offices in India in Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region.

ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engage in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across chemicals and lubricants businesses. The India planning teams are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics.

ExxonMobil’s LNG affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market-development activities.

The Global Business Center - Technology Center provides a range of technical and business support services for ExxonMobil’s operations around the globe.

ExxonMobil strives to make a positive contribution to the communities where we operate and its affiliates support a range of education, health and community-building programs in India. Read more about our Corporate Responsibility Framework.

To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India.

**What role you will play in our team**
---------------------------------------

Global Security Intelligence Advisors serve as experts in regional security issues, intelligence analysis and strategic assessment of security threats. They are responsible for the collection, analysis and dissemination of intelligence that provides advantages to decision makers across the corporation.

  

We are seeking an international security and intelligence professional with knowledge and experience of the Asia Pacific region to join the Global Security Intelligence team.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead the development, prioritization, and continuous refinement of intelligence requirements aligned to organizational needs, business priorities, and regional threat landscapes.
* Own and manage the Regional Collection Plan, ensuring collection strategies are proactive and aligned with regional intelligence requirements.
* Establish and maintain key internal relationships across the corporation.
* Establish and maintain strong external relationships to enhance collection and insight generation, including with security contacts, third party providers, business, academia, and counterparts in the energy industry and other private sector fields.
* Anticipate, monitor and report changes in threat conditions that impact or may impact ExxonMobil.
* Produce intelligence products that inform decision-making, including threat assessments, regional briefs, and forward-looking analysis.
* Conduct country threat assessments, ExxonMobil facility threat assessments, and ad hoc threat assessments as required.
* Develop strategies and plans for implementation of new or updated security intelligence practices, processes, or requirements.

Represent ExxonMobil in security industry forums.

**About You**
-------------

**Skills & Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Undergraduate degree in an area of study relevant to the position, for example international security.
* At least seven years of relevant work experience, preferably in government or private sector intelligence roles.
* Deep knowledge of security and international affairs issues in the Asia Pacific region.
* Strong understanding of the intelligence cycle and its application in a commercial environment, including substantial analytic tradecraft and critical thinking skills.
* Knowledge of wide range of Open Source intelligence methods and techniques.
* Strong oral presentation and briefing skills, with demonstrated experience briefing audiences and senior management.

* Excellent written English skills; ability to draft succinct, impactful intelligence briefings and assessments, often under time pressure.
* Adept at cultivating productive relationships and building broad networks across all levels, both within and outside the organization.
* Strong IT skills, specifically competence in use of Microsoft Office.
* Fluency in English.
* Ability to work independently in a global virtual team structure.
* Willingness and ability to travel, sometimes at short notice.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with Engineering Applications such as IPM, Kappa Ecrin (Saphir), Eclipse, Petrel RE, Intersect and CMG
* Experience in one or more programming languages such as MATLAB/C/Python
* Experience in computational and/or data science (e.g., machine learning, optimization)

**Your Benefits**
-----------------

An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last. Our commitment to you runs deep our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance and life. We offer you:

  

* Competitive compensation
* Medical plans, maternity leave and benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment benefits
* Retirement benefits
* Global networking & cross-functional opportunities
* Annual vacations & holidays
* Day care assistance program
* Training and development program
* Tuition assistance program
* Workplace flexibility policy
* Relocation program
* Transportation facility
  

Please note benefits may change from time to time without notice, subject to applicable laws. The benefits programs are based on the Company’s eligibility guidelines.

**Stay connected with us**
--------------------------

* Learn more about ExxonMobil in India, visit **ExxonMobil India** and **Energy Factor India****.**
* Follow us on **LinkedIn** and **ExxonMobil (@exxonmobil) • Instagram photos and videos**
* Like us on **Facebook**
* Subscribe our channel at **YouTube**

**EEO Statement**
-----------------

ExxonMobil is an Equal Opportunity Employer:

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin or disability status.

**Business solicitation and recruiting scams**
----------------------------------------------

ExxonMobil does not use recruiting or placement agencies that charge candidates an advance fee of any kind (e.g., placement fees, immigration processing fees, etc.). Follow the LINK to understand more about recruitment scams in the name of ExxonMobil.
